issue_context.title: 4.4.dev: .NET SDK detection is broken
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 622393c1156e6ee349a2636c28183021b1442cbc
- Reproducible in da230f384b90360ec108ce1be2347a327d68ca07
- Not Reproducible in 4e051ff6f7fee918b90e1871b4bc36c9f6fa7142

### System information

Godot v4.4.dev.mono (4e051ff6f) - Windows 10.0.22631 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 9 3900X 12-Core Processor (24 Threads)

### Issue description

When attempting to run the Godot Editor built with the mono module enabled, the notification is shown that no .NET SDK is detected. Attempting to load a project hard crashes the editor.

![net error](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/20fabe57-0984-4b65-b1d6-5c51c8840b0e)


I am very certain that this issue is related to [da230f384b90360ec108ce1be2347a327d68ca07] as this is the first commit at which it fails. 

### Steps to reproduce

- Attempt to run Godot with the mono module enabled and create / load a project.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
